summary: India’s inflation was broadly steady in July, holding within the Reserve Bank’s 2%-6% target range and cementing expectations policymakers will keep interest rates unchanged for some time.

title: Citi's Hollenhorst Sees Trend Toward Cooling Inflation
summary: Andrew Hollenhorst, chief US economist at Citi, discusses the outlook for today's US inflation report. "If we get a cool reading again this month, and we think that we will, then you have more of a trend toward cooling inflation," Hollenhorst tells Bloomberg Television. "And that's just a very, very different story than what we've been hearing from some Fed officials." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Market’s Momentum Darlings Resurface as Optical Stocks Take Off

title: MEMX Files to List Prediction Market-Style Bets on Earnings
summary: Exchange operator MEMX is looking to become the latest financial exchange to compete with prediction markets by offering binary bets on corporate earnings metrics, according to a representative for the company.

title: Emerging Stocks Rise on Tech as Currency Traders Await US CPI
summary: Emerging-market stocks rose, led by a rally in Asian chipmakers as upbeat results from AI infrastructure firms revived appetite for tech stocks. Developing-nation currencies were mixed before the publication of US inflation data later in the session.

title: IEA Says Oil Markets Are Facing a Wider Shortfall
summary: Global oil inventories will tumble this quarter at more than twice the rate previously estimated, according to the International Energy Agency. Markets face a shortfall of 1.8 million barrels a day as “renewed hostilities and maritime disruptions” in the Middle East undermine a production recovery, the IEA said in its monthly report. Bloomberg's Anthony di Paola reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CPI Day and What Katsu Curry Says About the Level of the Yen

title: Strategist Weighs September Fed Hike Amid Mixed Data
summary:
Laureline Renaud-Chatelain, fixed income strategy lead at Pictet Wealth Management, discussed the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike in September. She noted that the recent payroll data was somewhat surprising but indicated a stable labor market that is not adding inflationary pressure. Despite noisy and downwardly revised employment figures, the key focus remains on upcoming Consumer Price Index (CPI) prints, which will heavily influence the Fed's decision.

(Corrects name of guest in video). (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Norway $2.3 Trillion Fund Posts Best Quarter Since 2020
summary: Norway’s sovereign wealth fund, the world’s largest, reported its best quarterly return in six years, helped by gains from its holdings in global technology companies.

title: New Katsu Curry Index Rivals Big Mac Gauge to Show How Weak Yen Really Is
summary: A senior strategist at Bank of New York Mellon is using the price of a Japanese fast-food staple to get an accurate snapshot of the yen’s weakness as the impact of the recent intervention fades.

title: Gold Advances as Traders Watch US Inflation for Rate-Hike Clues
summary: Gold advanced, as traders weighed prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz while awaiting US inflation data for clues on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.

title: Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran Resigns Ahead of AGM Next Week
summary: Natarajan Chandrasekaran will step down as chairman of Tata Sons Pvt. when his term ends in February 2027, deepening a leadership crisis at the Indian conglomerate at a time when it’s spearheading the country’s push into high-tech sectors.

title: Most Electricity Sought for AI Data Centers in US Will Never Materialize
summary: More than two-thirds of the electricity sought for the artificial intelligence boom in the US isn’t likely to materialize due to “phantom” projects and long-shot pitches.

title: UAE Shuttles Iraqi Oil Exports Through the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co.’s trading arm is offering to shuttle exports of Iraqi oil through the Strait of Hormuz, using its dark-transit playbook to transport Basrah and other crude to refiners in Asia, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Why Romantasy May Soon Be a Billion-Dollar Business
summary: Romantasy has grown from a BookTok-driven obsession to a nearly billion-dollar business, powered by a largely female fandom scooping up special editions, merchandise, event tickets, audiobooks and more. The genre's rise is reshaping publishing and drawing retailers, creators and now Hollywood into one of the book industry’s most powerful new markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pimco Sees Fed on Hold Through 2026 as Inflation Moderates
summary: Marc Seidner, CIO for non-traditional strategies at Pimco, discusses the outlook for inflation, the US economy and Federal Reserve policy. "We're much less fussed about about the inflation outlook on a forward-looking basis than I think many in the market," Seidner tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pimco’s Seidner Says Angst Over Fed Credibility Is Unwarranted
summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. says market anxiety about the inflation-fighting credentials of the Federal Reserve is overdone and that US bond yields at current levels look attractive.
